senses.gloss:
--(Gavya) cow's milk for श्राद्ध;
1: M. १७. ३४.
not to be taken during nights.
2: M. १३१. ४३.
--a R. flowing in द्रविड in the भारत- वर्ष. भा. V. १९. १८; XI. 5. ३९. [page२-287+ २९]
--a lake in the नील hill. Br. II. १८. ६९.
(I)--a R. from the lake Payodam. Br. II. १८. ७०. वा. ४७. ६६.
(II)--a R. rising on the western side of the Meru mountain. वा. ४७. ६७.

--(also called सर्वयज्ञ, सर्वव्रत) a votive offering of the essence of तपस्, in honour of Hari to be observed for twelve days and in which Hari is represented in an image or in any other form; originally told about it by ब्रह्मा, कश्यप suggested to his wife Aditi to observe it; अदिती observed it as instructed by कश्यप, when Hari manifested Himself and promised to be born of her womb;
1: भा. VIII. १६. २५-60; १७. 1-१८.
observed by श्रद्धा.
2: IX. 1. १४.

--a R. from the ऋक्ष hill in भारतवर्ष
1: भा. V. १९. १८; Br. II. १६. ३२; वा. ४५. १०२; Vi. II. 3. ११.
visited by बलराम;
2: भा. X. ७९. २०.
sacred to पिन्गलेश्वरी and the पितृस्.
3: M. १३. ४४; २२. ३३. ६४; ११४. २७.
[page२-288+ २६]
